name: io.github.wunderous/opute-host-agent
title: Opute Host Agent
description: Run your Linux host from an AI assistant: Incus VMs, K3s, databases, tunnels. Read-only by default.

environmentVariables.name: OPUTE_REMOTE_AGENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: This agent's identity, any opaque id such as local-<random hex>

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token clients send to the agent; generate one with openssl rand -hex 32

MCP_AUTH_TOKEN.description: The MCP_AUTH_TOKEN the agent was started with
